answer: Guarantor budgets that halve with every vouch limit sybil farms: a sponsor's first guarantee can back 64 POA of standing, the next 32, reaching a nadir of 1 after seven vouches, when it stops. So 1,000 fakes need about 143 sponsors locking 127 POA each, roughly 18,000 POA. Each guarantee leaves an on-ledger pigment tracing an account to its sponsor; if audits catch duplicate answers, that sponsor's bond is slashed. Budgets cannot wander to fresh addresses, since those need vouching too, so colluders gain nothing by pooling. An honest agent needs one voucher and little capital.
